newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya coffee prices ease, looking for new levels.
newsitem.headline: Kenya coffee prices ease, looking for new levels.

text.p: Kenyan coffee prices eased on Tuesday at the weekly coffee auction in Nairobi, looking for new levels following a price reduction in the main New York market, auction officials said.
"What has happened is a slight market correction which the Kenyan market had not responded to," a trader said.
Grade ABs averaged $257 per 50 kg compared to $271 last week while grade Cs averaged $242 from $251.
The Coffee Board of Kenya said it sold 45,300 60-kg bags on offer compared to 45,000 bags sold last week.
